in_marathi.name: Ashvath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashvath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Ashvath refers to the divine horse vehicle of various gods, such as Indra and Agni. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ashva’ (horse) and ‘ath’ (vehicle).

in_bengali.name: Ashvath
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Horse vehicle
